messages:
emma: Heads-up: ca-central-1 warm-pool nodes failing to transition -> Provisioned after the network lockdown PR landed. Seeing repeated KMS handshake timeouts.
raj: Which change exactly? I reviewed the lockdown but didn't expect KMS to be impacted.
emma: The new egress ACL rule was applied to the warm-pool subnets and has a block for 0.0.0.0/0 above the allow for the NAT CIDR. It effectively dropped outbound 443 to KMS endpoints via NAT.
ops-bot: deploy-bot: network-lockdown v3.7.0 applied to ca-central-1 at 2026-03-24T09:12Z (change: NW-2026-210).
marta: paste logs: ```
keystore-proxy ERROR: tls connect: dial tcp 52.118.45.99:443: i/o timeout
agent[join]: state=ProvisioningPending attempts=4 reason="kms handshake timeout"
```
emma: We hit ~70% onboarding failures across the warm-pool and the autoscaler spawned extra nodes that also failed, causing churn.
raj: I can't edit ACLs due to the role-boundary transition. Only net-admins can now modify the ACLs.
ops-bot: infra-run: temporary ACL exception created id=EXC-CA-2026-211 by raj --allow dst=52.118.0.0/16:443 from=subnet/warm-pool-ca --expires 25m
emma: After the exception, onboarding backlog cleared in ~6 minutes. Healthy warm-pool nodes: 9 -> 46.
raj: Cost impact: churn + extra spinups ~8 GPU-hours. Rough cost delta USD ~2.1k for the incident window.
marta: Short-term mitigation accepted, but we need something less manual. Proposal: preflight validation that simulates a node provisioning during any egress/ACL change and fails the rollout if KMS decrypt fails.
compliance-bot: exception recorded id=EXC-CA-2026-211. Operator=raj. Reason="temp allowlist for keystore egress after ACL block". TTL=2026-03-24T09:37Z.
emma: Additional proposal: a scoped service-principal that can create very-limited network exceptions for ops without full net-admin role, with automatic audit trail and a max TTL.
raj: Also recommend we avoid blind 0.0.0.0/0 denies in warm-pool ACLs; prefer explicit deny lists and ordered rules with allow-before-deny semantics for service endpoints.
marta: Follow-ups: (1) add KMS e2e hook in the network PR pipeline, (2) create infra capability for ops to trigger audited temporary allowlists, (3) document NAT dependency mapping in the prefix-list/ACL handbook. I'll open an action item.
emma: Filed incident: https://issues.internal/RED-IF-7801 "ca-central ACL ordering blocked NAT -> keystore decrypt failures -> GPU onboarding churn". Attach logs, exception id, and cost estimate.
raj: I'll coordinate with net-admin to rework NW-2026-210 to use explicit endpoint rules and run a canary rollout.
emma: Thanks. Closing when PR merged and the preflight test is in place.
